annotations.title: Check how new or crowded an idea is

description: How much research already covers a product or research idea: matching works, works in the last two years, crowdedness (open, early, active, crowded), growth, who is working on it (researchers, institutions, companies), the closest prior work and related patents. For a written assessment, use the idea-validation prompt. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/innovation-radar on your Apify account (about $0.03 per idea; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

ideas.description: Ideas in plain words, e.g. "a window that generates solar power with perovskite tandem cells".

name: validate_idea

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.
